Workload Group Resource Add Workload Group
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/workloadGroups

Adds a workload group for an organization. .

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Workload group information

id
int32

A unique identifier assigned to the workload group

name
string

The name of the workload group

description
string

The description of the workload group

expressionJson
object
expression
string

The workload group expression containing tag types, tags, and their relationships.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the workload group was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
Responses
​
200
400
401
403
500

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
